evals.prompt: Our homepage needs a new hero. Fullscreen, looping background video, headline "Build sites that feel alive" with one short subline underneath. Dark theme, classic nav, sticky. The video will be supplied by the designer.
evals.expected_output: An app/components/sections/HeroSection.vue implementing the fullscreen hero layout with a <video data-media-id> element (no hardcoded src), the headline revealed with useTextReveal, and design-token classes only.
assertions: The video uses a data-media-id attribute and has no src attribute
The heading is animated with useTextReveal from the pre-installed text-motion composables
No hardcoded hex or rgb colors; only Tailwind design-token classes

evals.prompt: Can you build the hero for the landing page? I want the text on the left (headline, paragraph, two buttons) and a product photo on the right. Premium feel — add a subtle parallax to the image when scrolling.
evals.expected_output: A split hero: the section wrapper uses grid md:grid-cols-2, text and visual in their own columns, the image emitted through the media pipeline with a modest parallax effect, and no full-bleed absolute background.
assertions: Uses a split layout with the grid on the section wrapper, not absolute positioning for the halves
The product image uses and lets the pipeline inject :src
The visual does not use absolute inset-0 spanning the full hero section
Includes a CTA button with the shared hover/press interaction classes

evals.prompt: For the agency site I want something dramatic: a 3D particle background behind an oversized typographic headline (energetic intensity). The whole hero should feel like the type is the artwork.
evals.expected_output: A typographic hero that delegates the 3D layer to the pre-built ThreeScene.vue with a particles preset, never re-implementing Three.js, with fluid clamp() type sizing.
assertions: Does not inline Three.js/TresJS code in HeroSection.vue
The heading size uses clamp() rather than fixed text-{n}xl classes only
Uses the typographic layout with the 3D visual as a subtle backdrop
